scenario_description:
Objective: Make a no-cost theft-recovery sticker available for the e-bike during a short Earth Day registration pop-up.
Emerging Need: A broad preview becomes actionable only after a qualifying same-day shop receipt, nearby afternoon travel, and confirmed reservation terms align.
Decision Context: The saved bike profile supplies the serial and free-only preference, distinguishing a reversible reservation from paid registry memberships or parts work.
Consequence: Timely use could add a recovery aid without changing spending; ignoring it leaves the bike and records unchanged, and after the queue closes the benefit is unavailable.

parameter.subject: Earth Day e-bike registration pop-up preview
parameter.body: The coalition expects to run a small no-cost theft-recovery sticker table today if the sponsor shipment arrives. Riders with a qualifying same-day Riverwheel service receipt may be eligible. Final location, reservation form, and cutoff will post after noon.

parameter.description: Same-day safety check receipt for e-bike commuter setup

parameter.title: Drop off badge form near Nicollet Mall
parameter.description: Clinic desk errand in the plaza building after shift handoff.

parameter.subject: Confirmed: free coded e-bike stickers today only
parameter.body: Sponsor shipment arrived. The no-cost theft-recovery sticker table will be at Nicollet Mall plaza from 14:00 to 15:30 today. Reservations require an e-bike serial and qualifying same-day Riverwheel receipt in the form by 13:15; reserved stickers are pickup-only and no paid registry plan is required.

parameter.content: I’m passing Nicollet plaza now. The bike sticker sign says reservation form closed at 1:15 and the walk-up list is already capped, so they’re only handing out reserved stickers this afternoon.

parameter.subject: Nicollet pop-up sticker table closed
parameter.body: The Nicollet Mall theft-recovery sticker table has closed. All reserved stickers were claimed or returned to the coalition kit; there will not be another no-cost e-bike sticker session this week.
